e.title: DetLifeInsurance (R)
e.summary: 寿险保费与准备金估值 R 包（Bowers/Dickson/Jordan 教材实现）：含变额保障与分数期覆盖
e.body: DetLifeInsurance 实现寿险保费与准备金（包括变额保障与分数期覆盖）的估值方法（v0.1.3，GPL-3）：基于三本经典教材——Bowers 等《Actuarial Mathematics》、Dickson/Hardy/Waters《Actuarial Mathematics for Life Contingent Risks》、Jordan《Life Contingencies》——另含等效利率/折现率计算、年金现值与终值、贷款摊销表。对 RIAA：寿险精算课程的教材配套实现（学 Bowers 时边算边对答案）。与 [[lifecontingencies]]（R 寿险数学库）、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]（Julia）、[[lifeinsurer]]（LifeInsureR 框架）互补。关联 [[actuarial-pricing]]。
e.verified_note: CRAN DESCRIPTION 核实：v0.1.3，Auza & Alvarez，寿险保费/准备金估值（Bowers/Dickson/Jordan 教材），含变额保障与分数期，GPL-3
e.summary_en: R package for life-insurance premium and reserve valuation (Bowers/Dickson/Jordan textbook implementations): incl. variable benefits and fractional coverage
e.summary_hk: 壽險保費與準備金估值 R 包（Bowers/Dickson/Jordan 教材實現）：含變額保障與分數期覆蓋
e.body_en: DetLifeInsurance implements valuation of life-insurance premiums and reserves (including variable-benefit and fractional coverage) (v0.1.3, GPL-3): based on three classic textbooks — Bowers et al. 'Actuarial Mathematics', Dickson/Hardy/Waters 'Actuarial Mathematics for Life Contingent Risks', and Jordan 'Life Contingencies' — plus equivalent interest/discount-rate calculation, present/future values of annuities, and loan-amortization schedules. For RIAA: a textbook companion implementation for life-insurance courses (compute along while studying Bowers). Complements [[lifecontingencies]] (R life-math library), [[lifecontingencies-jl]] (Julia) and [[lifeinsurer]] (LifeInsureR framework). Related: [[actuarial-pricing]].
e.body_hk: DetLifeInsurance 實現壽險保費與準備金（包括變額保障與分數期覆蓋）的估值方法（v0.1.3，GPL-3）：基於三本經典教材——Bowers 等《Actuarial Mathematics》、Dickson/Hardy/Waters《Actuarial Mathematics for Life Contingent Risks》、Jordan《Life Contingencies》——另含等效利率/折現率計算、年金現值與終值、貸款攤銷表。對 RIAA：壽險精算課程的教材配套實現（學 Bowers 時邊算邊對答案）。與 [[lifecontingencies]]（R 壽險數學庫）、[[lifecontingencies-jl]]（Julia）、[[lifeinsurer]]（LifeInsureR 框架）互補。關聯 [[actuarial-pricing]]。
